name: Product development at the hardware level

checks.title: Hardware Safety Requirements specified
checks.description: Verify HSR exist with traceability to Technical Safety Requirements and safety goals.

checks.title: Hardware architecture and safety mechanisms
checks.description: Confirm HW architecture identifies safety mechanisms, diagnostic coverage, and independence.

checks.title: Quantitative hardware metrics computed
checks.description: Check SPFM, LFM, and PMHF are calculated and justified for the target ASIL.

checks.title: FMEDA performed and linked to HSR
checks.description: Verify FMEDA exists with assumptions, failure modes, diagnostic coverage, and links to HSR.

checks.title: Hardware verification plan and results
checks.description: Confirm HW verification covers safety mechanisms and quantitative targets with pass/fail results.

checks.title: SEooC hardware assumptions and integration constraints
checks.description: If HW SEooC, confirm assumptions of use and integration constraints are defined and communicated.
